emerging_themes: The >= vs > discrepancy: three tools define 'enough votes' differently. Canonical threshold function needed.
Sequential (RULE 4) vs parallel (tree-walk) proposal processing: code ahead of governance.
Pipeline ships as recommendation engine, not execution engine. The authorization-to-commit gap remains the central blocker.
Vote entropy analysis: 43.5% efficiency, 82% concentration in one proposal. Runaway winner, not deliberation.
Bug fixes through new code > patching old code: community evolves by replacement, not repair.
